day2_broadcast_1.text: *The fourth-period bell rang. Lunchtime. Just as students began getting up from their seats one by one, a sharp crackle of static burst from the speaker.*

day2_broadcast_2.text: *Through the static, low mumbled fragments cut in and out—almost like numbers, or names.*

day2_broadcast_3.text: *All at once, everyone raised their heads and looked up at the speaker.*

day2_broadcast_3a.text: *...Two seconds. Three. It abruptly cut out. Then, Ms. Eunsu's voice came through, crystal clear.*

day2_broadcast_4.text: It's lunchtime. Students, please proceed in an orderly manner.

day2_broadcast_5.text:
*A speck of dust beneath the speaker trembled once.

Around me, classmates grabbed their phones and stood up from their seats as if nothing had happened. Someone picked right back up on the joke they were telling a moment ago.*

day2_broadcast_6.text: *I turned around. Seolhwa was looking at me, lips pressed tightly together.*

day2_broadcast_7.text: *Seolhwa's fingers tapped the corner of her desk three times. The exact same rhythm as the broadcast cutting out.*

day2_lunch_start.text: *Footsteps swell down the hallway as students head toward the cafeteria.*

choices: Go to the library to see Yuna

day2_lunch_sea_1.text: *The two-tier lunchbox Sea opens looks carefully put together: chicken cutlet, flower-cut carrots, mini gimbap.*

day2_lunch_sea_2.text: ...How early did you get up to make all this?

day2_lunch_sea_3.text: If someone eats it, there's less left over.

day2_lunch_sea_5.text: My mom taught me. We cooked together since elementary school.

day2_lunch_sea_6.text: Do you still make it together? I'd have crammed everything into one compartment.

day2_lunch_sea_8.text: *Sea trails off and picks up a piece of mini kimbap with her chopsticks.*

day2_lunch_sea_9.text: One compartment in my lunch box is always empty. Today, I just filled it.

day2_lunch_sea_11.text: It's fine—just glad you're enjoying it.

day2_lunch_sea_12.text:
*Sea sets her lunchbox lid in front of me like a small plate and shares a few pieces of mini kimbap onto it. An extra little fork is clipped inside the lid.*

Feels like I'm eating your share too. Thanks, I'll enjoy it.

day2_lunch_sea_13.text: {name}, what are you doing this weekend?

day2_lunch_sea_14.text: Nothing really. I don't even know the neighborhood yet. What about you?

day2_lunch_sea_15.text: Then do you want to go downtown on Saturday? Let's go to a cafe. There's a great croffle place.

day2_lunch_sea_19.text: No. You just answered so quickly.

day2_lunch_sea_20.text:
*Sea lowers her head as if concentrating on her lunch, then hands me one earbud. The track is already just before the chorus.*

Is this the band you mentioned? I thought we'd listen from the beginning.

day2_lunch_sea_21.text: Yeah, that band. My favorite way to listen is starting right from this chorus.

day2_lunch_sea_22.text: *Catching a glimpse of her lock screen, I spot a music widget title above one lyric line—'Before the night erases the name…'—right before Sea flips the phone face down.*

day2_lunch_sea_23.text: I'll show you the lyrics later. How do you like the song?

day2_lunch_sea_25.text:
*Sea slowly winds the earbud cord around two fingers.*

Thanks for sharing the song. Now I'm curious about their other tracks.

day2_lunch_yuna_1.text: *Yuna is fiddling with her camera. A corner seat in the library. A bag of snacks sits beside her.*

day2_lunch_yuna_2.text: Sunbae! You came? Look at what I took today.

day2_lunch_yuna_3.text: *I flip through the photos. The hill behind school, the gym, a cat...*

day2_lunch_yuna_4.text: You take good photos. Where did you take this?

day2_lunch_yuna_5.text: Behind the gym. It's always in the same spot, so it's easy to find.

day2_lunch_yuna_6.text: You must have photographed it a lot.

day2_lunch_yuna_7.text: Yes. If I keep taking pictures, I can see what's changed. Look here.

day2_lunch_yuna_8.text:
*The cat's face is round on the screen.*

Even rounder up close. Did you wait for that shot?

day2_lunch_yuna_9.text: Do you take photos too, sunbae?

day2_lunch_yuna_10.text: No, just my phone camera. I don't take pictures very often.

day2_lunch_yuna_11.text: You still have a good eye, though. You spotted the gym shot right away just now.

day2_lunch_yuna_12.text: The framing was clean, so it caught my eye right away. Guess it's from taking so many photos?

day2_lunch_yuna_13.text: If you miss it, you can't take it again.

day2_lunch_yuna_14.text:
*Yuna's finger stops on the screen.*

What? Aren't you showing me the next one?

day2_lunch_yuna_15.text: Sunbae... have you been to this school before?

day2_lunch_yuna_16.text: No? My first day was yesterday.

day2_lunch_yuna_18.text: *My finger stops over the gym photo I just flipped past.*

day2_lunch_yuna_19.text: Oh, it's nothing. I just remember seeing a similar photo.

day2_lunch_yuna_20.text: *Dates line up neatly down the camera preview list—except the very first photo has a blank timestamp.*

day2_lunch_yuna_21.text: Sometimes that field goes blank when I move old files over. If you're ever interested in the photography club, please stop by anytime—I have plenty of photos to sort through.

day2_lunch_yuna_23.text: Yes. No pressure. If we look together, you might notice things I missed.

day2_lunch_yuna_24.text:
*Yuna wraps both hands around her camera, the strap creasing back and forth under her thumb.*

Got it. I'll stop by when I get a chance.

day2_lunch_riin_1.text: Since you just transferred in, we don't have a health chart yet. Let's do a quick checkup.

day2_lunch_riin_2.text: Just blood pressure, eyesight, and weight, right?

day2_lunch_riin_3.text: Any allergies to food or medicine?

day2_lunch_riin_5.text:
*After slipping off the blood-pressure cuff and finishing the eye chart, she flips the clipboard sheet.*

All done. Everything looks healthy.

day2_lunch_riin_6.text:
*She turns to the second page of the record and fills in the blanks beneath the blood pressure readings, one by one.*

That's a lot to write down. The checkup was quick.

day2_lunch_riin_8.text: *With the tip of her pen resting on the date field, Nurse Riin pauses for a moment and looks up at me.*

day2_lunch_riin_10.text: Where did that come from? Do dreams go in my health record too?

day2_lunch_riin_11.text: We check sleep patterns the first week after a transfer. A lot of students get foggy during the day.

day2_lunch_riin_12.text: I did have a dream yesterday. When I woke up, though, my pillow was a little damp.

day2_lunch_riin_13.text: *Nurse Riin taps the paper once with the tip of her pen, then fills in today's date where she had left it blank.*

day2_lunch_riin_14.text: If any scenes come to mind, tell me. I'll write them down.

day2_lunch_riin_16.text:
*The checkup is over and I'm about to leave when Nurse Riin takes out tea from a cabinet.*

The examination's all done, right?

day2_lunch_riin_17.text: If you're not in a rush, have a cup of tea before heading back. It's chamomile.

day2_lunch_riin_18.text:
*I sit on the infirmary sofa. Sunlight stretches through the gaps in the curtains. Nurse Riin sits opposite me.*

Is it okay to stay for tea? I only came for the checkup.

day2_lunch_riin_19.text: How's school life treating you so far?

day2_lunch_riin_20.text: Better than I expected. Everyone's been nice.

day2_lunch_riin_24.text:
*Ms. Riin cups the mug in both hands and gazes out the window.*

If I say I'm adjusting fine, does that wrap up the record?

day2_lunch_riin_25.text: That's usually what goes on an initial adjustment check.

day2_lunch_riin_26.text: Have you ever had to pretend you were okay somewhere unfamiliar too?

day2_lunch_riin_27.text: *Ms. Riin looks at me for a moment, then drops her gaze to the teacup. No answer comes.*

day2_lunch_riin_28.text: Finish your tea and head back up. You'll be late for afternoon class.

day2_lunch_riin_29.text:
*Another round stain appeared on the saucer. Nurse Riin looked only at that stain for a moment, then smiled.*

I've finished. I'll wipe the saucer.

day2_lunch_rooftop_1.text: *I'm climbing the stairs to the rooftop when I hear a voice from the landing.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_2.text: ...Yes, I submitted the approval. This time too, five days.

day2_lunch_rooftop_3.text: *I make a sound and the teacher hangs up.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_6.text: It's the start of the semester, so there's a lot of paperwork. Work from the education office.

day2_lunch_rooftop_7.text: *Ms. Eunsu gave a light laugh and walked past down the stairs. Right before her screen went dark, I caught a brief glimpse of the call timer: '00:00'.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_8.text: *I'm on the rooftop. The wind blows. No lunch box, but I unwrap a convenience store rice ball.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_9.text: *I can see the mountains beyond the school. My eyes seek out the bent cell in the wire mesh first.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_9a.text: *I lean against the railing and eat a rice ball. No one else is here. It's quiet.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_10.text: *As I folded the samgak-gimbap wrapper, my eyes stopped on the expiration-date box with the number 5 printed in it. The words I'd just heard had cut off at the same number.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_10a.text: *Leaning by the railing, a Student Safety App alert pops onto my phone screen: 'D-1 Field Day Form Due.'*

day2_lunch_rooftop_10b.text: *I cleared the notification. The plastic wrapper crumpled softly in my hand.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_11.text: *Wind whips my hair. The second I shut my eyes, someone laughs right beside my ear. I snap them open to find only an empty rice-ball wrapper fluttering on the railing.*

day2_lunch_sea_carrot_1.text: Why are the carrots shaped like flowers? That must've taken a lot of work to cut.

day2_lunch_sea_carrot_2.text: There’s a cutter for that. Being class president doesn’t make me a knife expert.

day2_lunch_sea_carrot_3.text: Then I’ll take the wonky flower.

day2_lunch_sea_carrot_4.text: I hid that one for myself. Nice catch.

day2_lunch_riin_cup_1.text: That cup handle's hot. Lift it by the saucer.

day2_lunch_riin_cup_2.text: Right. Drinking tea is harder than the checkup.

day2_lunch_riin_cup_3.text: I'm the one who ran the checkup. Do I have to blow on your tea too?

day2_lunch_sea_ticket_choice.text: *Sea tucks the coiled earphones into a small pouch and looks up at me.*
choices: Ask exactly where we should meet on Saturday
Ask about the playlist name on the phone she just turned over

day2_lunch_sea_tkt_1.text: You said we're going into town on Saturday. What time, and where should we meet?

day2_lunch_sea_tkt_2.text: *Sea's fingertips pause briefly on the pouch zipper.*

day2_lunch_sea_tkt_3.text: Let's sort it out by message on Friday night. Setting a time already makes it feel like homework.

day2_lunch_sea_tkt_4.text: You asked to make plans first. Now you're putting them off.

day2_lunch_sea_tkt_5.text: I'm not putting anything off. I want to see if you remember until Friday.

day2_lunch_sea_tkt_6.text: Huh, you still haven't torn off the stub? Why'd you forget our weekend plans already?

day2_lunch_sea_tkt_7.text: As long as you remember. I'll buy you a croffle, so don't change your mind on Friday evening.

day2_lunch_sea_tkt_8.text: I saw your screen when you turned your phone over. Was that playlist named after a date?

day2_lunch_sea_tkt_9.text: *Sea pushed her phone deep into her uniform pocket.*

day2_lunch_sea_tkt_10.text: I make a new list every season. I can't bring myself to delete the old ones, so I keep them.

day2_lunch_sea_tkt_11.text: Do you listen to similar songs on all of them?

day2_lunch_sea_tkt_12.text: Yeah. When I get hooked on a song, I play it over and over until I'm sick of it. The bell's about to ring. Let's wipe the desks.

day2_lunch_sea_tkt_13.text: *Sea pulled out a wet wipe and started with the corner of my desk.*

day2_lunch_yuna_map_choice.text: *Yuna was about to switch off her camera, but hesitated when she noticed me watching.*
choices: Look closely at the shadow in the first photo without a timestamp
Ask where the old building with the photography clubroom is

day2_lunch_yuna_map_1.text: Wait, don't turn it off. Isn't that long shape at the bottom right of the first photo someone's shadow?

day2_lunch_yuna_map_2.text: *Yuna swallowed and lowered the screen brightness one level.*

day2_lunch_yuna_map_3.text: It's mine. Shadows stretch out from your feet when you shoot into the light.

day2_lunch_yuna_map_4.text: There's another one overlapping yours. About my height.

day2_lunch_yuna_map_5.text: It must be the streetlamp's shadow. The lens is old, so it distorts the edges a little.

day2_lunch_yuna_map_6.text: The shoulders looked too clear to blame the lens.

day2_lunch_yuna_map_7.text: You always look in the corners, sunbae. Next time I'll take one somewhere with a cleaner background.

day2_lunch_yuna_map_8.text: Where's the photography clubroom? I didn't see it on the main building map.

day2_lunch_yuna_map_9.text: Below the stairs in the old building, on the semi-basement level. The windows are small, so it's perfect for a darkroom.

day2_lunch_yuna_map_10.text: Doesn't it scare you, being there alone?

day2_lunch_yuna_map_11.text: It's safer inside than outside. Lock the door, and no one comes down.

day2_lunch_yuna_map_12.text: *Yuna folded the snack wrapper and put it in the front pocket of her bag.*

day2_lunch_yuna_map_13.text: I might come find you first at lunch tomorrow. Don't be surprised.

day2_lunch_riin_pulse_choice.text: *A ring of water on the saucer caught the fluorescent light.*
choices: Wipe the saucer and look at the older chart beneath mine
Bring up the dark hallway memory that flickered in my sleep last night

day2_lunch_riin_pls_1.text: *Pulling a tissue to wipe the saucer, I notice an identical sheet tucked underneath my form.*

day2_lunch_riin_pls_2.text: Ms. Riin, is that another transfer student's chart under mine? The blood-pressure numbers are exactly the same.

day2_lunch_riin_pls_3.text: *Ms. Riin smoothly pulled the clipboard toward her and put it in a drawer.*

day2_lunch_riin_pls_4.text: It's a sample with last year's average readings. I keep it underneath for reference when I fill in the numbers.

day2_lunch_riin_pls_5.text: But it had pencil marks on it.

day2_lunch_riin_pls_6.text: The print was faint, so I went over it. You have sharp eyes, {name}.

day2_lunch_riin_pls_7.text: I just thought it was strange that the numbers matched.

day2_lunch_riin_pls_8.text: Actually, I think I briefly dreamed last night about walking down a dark school hallway—every door locked, only the exit signs lit...

day2_lunch_riin_pls_9.text: *Ms. Riin stopped as she was setting her cup in the sink.*

day2_lunch_riin_pls_10.text: Did you go all the way to the end?

day2_lunch_riin_pls_11.text: No. A bell woke me up halfway.

day2_lunch_riin_pls_12.text: Good. Don't go to the end of a dark hallway, even in a dream. You'll only fall too deeply asleep and struggle to wake up.

day2_lunch_riin_pls_13.text: *She turned on the tap and rinsed her cup. Running water filled the infirmary.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_step_choice.text: *As the rooftop wind eased, I sensed different movements beyond the fence and down the stairs.*
choices: Look down at the flowerbed behind the main building below the bent fence
Follow the sound of shoes down the emergency stairs

day2_lunch_rooftop_stp_1.text: *I bent through a gap in the fence and looked down four floors at the flowerbed.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_stp_2.text: *Down beside the gravel drainage trench lies a single white indoor slipper coated in dust.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_stp_3.text: Did someone drop it out a window?

day2_lunch_rooftop_stp_4.text: *Across the top, marker-written lettering of a name has bled black in old rain.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_stp_5.text: *As I tried to look closer, a third-floor staffroom window shut and flashed sunlight into my eyes.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_stp_6.text: *Shaking my head, I step back from the rail, pull open the rooftop door, and head down the stairs—the faded shoe still stuck in my mind.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_stp_7.text: *I opened the rooftop door and peered over the emergency-stair railing at the floor below.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_stp_8.text: *The steady taps of low heels stopped abruptly outside the third-floor hallway door.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_stp_9.text: *As I take a step down, concrete dust settles lightly onto the tips of my indoor slippers.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_stp_10.text: *On the third-floor landing lies a label sticker that looks like it peeled off a document binder.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_stp_11.text: *I picked it up. The printed words '13th Curriculum Review' were half torn off at the corner.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_stp_12.text: *I flatten the creased corner and slip it into my pocket. It doesn't read like a routine curriculum audit—more like a date pasted over another printout.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_stp_13.text: *I pull open the door to the classroom corridor just as the afternoon bell starts to ring.*
